title: Add playground landscape background to Home and ensure end-to-end user flow works reliably

requirements.text: Generate a new pixel-art style Home page background image depicting a playground landscape with pets playing in the distance (no UI text embedded in the image). Store it as a static asset under frontend/public/assets/generated and ensure it can be referenced from React via a stable public path.

quotes: make the home page background look like the landscape of a playground where pets are playing in the background.

acceptanceCriteria: A new background image file exists at frontend/public/assets/generated/playground-landscape-bg.dim_1920x1080.png
The image visually reads as a playground landscape scene with small pets playing in the background, in a cohesive pixel-art style
No text, logos, or UI elements are baked into the image

requirements.text: Apply the new playground landscape background to the Home (session setup) screen in a way that preserves readability and the existing pixel-desktop theme. The background must not interfere with interactions (forms/buttons) and must not obscure the persistent PetOverlay when a session is active.

quotes: make the home page background look like the landscape of a playground where pets are playing in the background.

acceptanceCriteria: When the current screen is Home/Setup, the playground background is visible behind the content
Session setup form content remains legible (e.g., via an overlay tint/blur layer or solid card background) in both light and dark mode
Interactive controls on the Home/Setup screen remain clickable (background layer does not capture pointer events)
When a session is active and PetOverlay is shown, the overlay remains visible above the background and Home content

requirements.text: Make the app end-to-end functional by ensuring the complete flow works without runtime errors for both authenticated and unauthenticated states: login (Internet Identity) → profile setup (if missing) → start session → focus timer → transition to break → save completed session to backend → view session history in Progress, with graceful handling when the user is not logged in (no unauthorized traps causing a broken UI).

quotes: Also make this whole thing end-to-end functional.

acceptanceCriteria: Unauthenticated users can load the app and use the Home/Setup screen without the UI breaking due to failed backend queries (no uncaught exceptions from unauthorized calls)
After logging in, if no profile exists, the ProfileSetupDialog appears and saving a profile results in the app continuing normally
Starting a session from Home/Setup navigates to Focus and the countdown behaves normally (pause/resume/end still work)
When the focus phase completes and the app transitions to Break, the completed session is saved exactly once via the backend addSession call
After at least one completed session, Progress shows the session in “Recent Sessions” without requiring a page refresh
If the user navigates between Home and Progress during an active session, the session state remains active and does not reset (no broken navigation/state)

requirements.text: Use saved user settings (focus duration, break duration, wasted platforms) to prefill and synchronize the Home/Setup experience and distraction check-ins, so the default configuration is consistent across Home and Progress Settings.

quotes: Also make this whole thing end-to-end functional.

acceptanceCriteria: When logged in and user settings exist, the Home/Setup screen initializes focus and break duration inputs using the saved defaults
Updating settings in Progress (focus/break/platforms) and saving them persists to the backend and is reflected when returning to Home/Setup
The distraction platform list used by “I got distracted” reflects the saved wastedPlatforms list when logged in
When not logged in, the app uses local defaults and does not attempt settings persistence

constraints: Do not edit any files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui (compose these components instead).
Keep backend logic in the single Motoko actor (backend/main.mo). Create backend/migration.mo only if existing stable state must be migrated.
nonGoals: Do not add a new authentication provider beyond Internet Identity.
Do not add real-time features (WebSockets, push notifications, live multiplayer).
Do not redesign non-Home screens beyond what is necessary to keep the end-to-end flow functional and visually consistent.

required: Pixel-art playground landscape background with small pets playing in the distance (playground-landscape-bg.dim_1920x1080.png)
